lines.zh: 关节卡了一下，我又往前走。
lines.en: A joint catches, then I walk on.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，脚掌砸在地上。
lines.en: Step by step, my feet slam the floor.

lines.zh: 布料破的地方，露出里面的铁。
lines.en: Where the cloth tore, the metal shows.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿走，声音很重。
lines.en: I drag one leg. The sound is heavy.

lines.zh: 我的脚在地板上擦出声。
lines.en: My feet scrape along the floor.

lines.zh: 我停下来，头慢慢转过去。
lines.en: I stop and my head turns slowly.
The boards creak as I cross them.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵歪了，听不太清。
lines.en: One ear is bent; I can't hear well.

lines.zh: 我抬手，扶了一下自己的下巴。
lines.en: I raise a hand and settle my jaw.

lines.zh: 身上的旧布，一动就掉渣。
lines.en: The old cloth sheds dust when I move.
I circle the corridor looking for a way out.
A misstep. I stop for three seconds.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，眼睛里的光很暗。
lines.en: I stand here, the light in my eyes dim.

lines.zh: 机器声在我身体里嗡嗡响。
lines.en: A motor hums inside me.

lines.zh: 我在张望，其实什么都没看清。
lines.en: I look around, though I see nothing clearly.
This body should have been scrapped long ago.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬手指，只动了一根。
lines.en: I lift a finger. Only one moves.

lines.zh: 舞台下面很黑，我待着挺好。
lines.en: Under the stage is dark. I'm fine here.

lines.zh: 我的下巴合不严，一直在响。
lines.en: My jaw won't close; it keeps clicking.

lines.zh: 布里面塞的东西，动了一下。
lines.en: What's stuffed inside the cloth shifted.
I do nothing. I wait for night.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一件没人要的旧家具。
lines.en: I stand like discarded furniture.
You stand there, and my head turns slowly.

lines.zh: 我认得活人，也认得慌张。
lines.en: I know the living, and I know panic.
You're too far from the door.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，眼皮不会眨。
lines.en: I lift my eyes to you. They never blink.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，很久没闻到了。
lines.en: I haven't smelled that on a person in a long time.

lines.zh: 我不急，我的耐心是铁做的。
lines.en: I'm in no hurry. My patience is made of iron.
Step back once, and I'll remember it.

lines.zh: 别拍手，那声音会引来别人。
lines.en: Don't clap. That sound draws others.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，是在算你到门的距离。
lines.en: My head is tilted, measuring you to the door.

lines.zh: 这么近，你已经听得见马达了。
lines.en: This close, you can hear the motor.
A patch of cloth tore; metal shows.
I don't retreat. I can't.
The motor is racing now.

lines.zh: 这一下打在铁架上，很响。
lines.en: That struck the frame. Loud.

lines.zh: 我的头歪了，我慢慢掰回来。
lines.en: My head is crooked. I straighten it slowly.
Something inside has come loose.

lines.zh: 我不会流血，但我会停下来。
lines.en: I don't bleed, but I do stop.

lines.zh: 别打了，我只是想走完这条走廊。
lines.en: Stop. I only wanted to finish this corridor.
My knee gave; I caught the wall.
I'm still here. So is the sound.

lines.zh: 那东西放桌上，别递给我。
lines.en: Leave it on the table; don't hand it to me.
I bend down and a chain of joints pops.
I've eaten this before, long ago.
I reach out, fingers slow.
I pick it up, look at it, and don't eat.
It tastes like many years ago.

lines.zh: 这玩意，塞进胸口的洞里。
lines.en: This goes into the hole in my chest.

lines.zh: 我不饿，但我记得怎么吃。
lines.en: I'm not hungry, but I remember how.

lines.zh: 你手举得很稳，胆子不小。
lines.en: Your hand is steady. Nervy of you.
So much. I can take my time.
Hitting me is like hitting a wall.
I don't move. You do.

lines.zh: 我的外壳很硬，你的手呢？
lines.en: My shell is hard. How about your hand?

lines.zh: 你从我身边挤过去，我转得很慢。
lines.en: You squeeze past and I turn too slowly.
One bump and my cloth tore again.

lines.zh: 我压过来，体重不是活人能挡的。
lines.en: I bear down. No living body stops this weight.

lines.zh: 脚下的地板被我踩塌一块。
lines.en: A floorboard buckled under my foot.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸口，里面是空的。
lines.en: You hit my chest. It's hollow.
I lift a foot and step over you. Slowly.
Steady. I don't like being pushed.
I'm only a shell.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，里面是空的。
lines.en: Don't come so close. It's hollow inside.

lines.zh: 我很久没有被人这样看着。
lines.en: It's been long since anyone looked at me like this.
Do you want to hold me? I'm cold.

lines.zh: 我记得有一首歌，唱给孩子的。
lines.en: I remember a song, sung to children.

lines.zh: 我的手太大了，会碰到你。
lines.en: My hands are too big. They'll bump you.
Don't be scared when I sing.

lines.zh: 我们这样站着，也算是陪着。
lines.en: Standing like this counts as company.
I'll be here until dawn.
When you leave, don't look back.
I bend, and my spine pops a series of times.
I pinch it with my broken fingers.

lines.zh: 这东西太小，我差点捏碎。
lines.en: So small I nearly crushed it.

lines.zh: 我把它放进胸口的洞里。
lines.en: I drop it into the cavity in my chest.
Yours. I don't keep it.
There's more. I take it all.

lines.zh: 我举起来看，眼睛里的光晃了晃。
lines.en: I hold it up; the light in my eyes flickers.

lines.zh: 我忘了刚才要拿它做什么。
lines.en: I forget what I meant to do with it.
It fell. I picked it up three times.
Put it away. Don't leave it in the corridor.

lines.zh: 你打了我，那我就记住你了。
lines.en: You hit me. Now I remember you.
I turn my head. Slowly.
This iron doesn't tire.

lines.zh: 棕色的布，从我手臂上裂开。
lines.en: Brown cloth splits from my arm.
The door is no longer on your side.
My jaw is barely hanging on.

lines.zh: 马达声变大了，你听见了吧。
lines.en: The motor got louder. You hear it.
I don't shout, and I don't rush.
You've backed to the wall. Good.
What comes next is slow.
This corridor has one door.

lines.zh: 你藏的那排座位我知道。
lines.en: I know the row of seats you're hiding in.
When you stop, I'm closer.
An old body can still walk a long way.
What you did just now hurt.
My head tilts, then rights itself.
I follow, footfall by footfall.
Wherever you run, I can hear it.
I don't need speed. I just don't stop.

lines.zh: 你回头看，会看见我在走。
lines.en: Look back and you'll see me walking.
I could find you with my eyes shut.
Listen. The motor never stops.
The door ahead is locked.

lines.zh: 你在这条走廊里绕了两圈。
lines.en: You've circled this corridor twice.
In the dark, my eyes shine brightest.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸把灰尘吹起来。
lines.en: Your breathing stirs the dust.
Only an iron frame sits in my chest.
Every step lands solid.

lines.zh: 你躲进柜子，我也听得见。
lines.en: Hide in a locker. I still hear you.
The lights on this floor are nearly out.
Not a race of speed. A contest of patience.

lines.zh: 你后退的声音，我听清了。
lines.en: I heard you back away.
Almost within reach of you.

lines.zh: 舞台的灯灭了，喊也没用。
lines.en: The stage lights are out. Shouting won't help.

lines.zh: 这身破布，看起来慢，其实不慢。
lines.en: This ragged cloth looks slow. It isn't.
One last corridor left for you.
I raise a hand and swing.
That blow will make bones ring.

lines.zh: 这具旧皮套，关节都在响。
lines.en: This old suit — every joint creaks.
My fingers are too thick to grip well.

lines.zh: 我的手掌盖住你的后背。
lines.en: My palm covers your whole back.
Iron meeting flesh makes a dull sound.
My jaw strikes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你挡了一下，手应该断了。
lines.en: You blocked it. Your arm should be broken.
After the blow I pause a moment.
This one is for all those years.
I don't shout. I just swing.
Withered claws are still long enough.

lines.zh: 我抬起两只手，一起砸下去。
lines.en: Both hands up, then down together.

lines.zh: 布被扯开，露出里面的铁架。
lines.en: The cloth tears and the frame shows.
My strength never diminished.
You're down. I'm still standing.

lines.zh: 马达停了一拍，又转起来。
lines.en: The motor missed a beat, then resumed.
I don't look at your face.

lines.zh: 我的手掌比你整个人还宽。
lines.en: My palm is broader than your whole body.
I bring it down and the floor splits.

lines.zh: 我从舞台的阴影里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the stage's shadow.

lines.zh: 灯闪了一下，我就在这了。
lines.en: The light flickered, and here I am.

lines.zh: 关节一节一节地撑起来。
lines.en: My joints straighten one after another.
There's someone in the building again.
I lift a foot; the floor creaks once.
Dust falls from my cloth.

lines.zh: 马达声先响，然后我才动。
lines.en: The motor starts first, then I move.

lines.zh: 我看了看门，也看了看窗。
lines.en: I look at the door, then the window.
I know this showroom well.

lines.zh: 我站在角落里，等你过来。
lines.en: I'll stand in the corner and wait for you.
This night still has a long way to go.

lines.zh: 我醒了，虽然我从没睡着。
lines.en: I'm awake, though I never slept.

lines.zh: 火燎过布面，味道很难闻。
lines.en: Fire swept over the cloth. The smell is foul.

lines.zh: 我落地时零件散了一地。
lines.en: Parts scattered everywhere when I landed.

lines.zh: 水灌进铁壳里，我短路了。
lines.en: Water poured into the shell; I shorted out.

lines.zh: 炸得我的布全烧起来了。
lines.en: The blast set my cloth burning.
The flying thing stuck in my casing.

lines.zh: 有股力让我的马达停了一拍。
lines.en: Something made my motor skip a beat.

lines.zh: 我不会饿，可我走得越来越慢。
lines.en: I don't hunger, but I walk slower and slower.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的电路全乱了。
lines.en: Lightning struck; my circuits scrambled.

lines.zh: 这里没有地板，我踩不到东西。
lines.en: No floor here. Nothing to stand on.
